description: List every feature log in the active history (All-logs/<active>/) with its derived lifecycle status (IN_PROGRESS / PASSED / FAILED / SUSPENDED / CLOSED / unknown) and the active marker. Use this to choose which feature to resume with cpfs_continue_feature — the MCP server does not auto-pick an active feature by file mtime. Use cpfs_list_histories / cpfs_use_history to switch which history is active.
name: cpfs_list_features
